title: Shared HTTP cache variant isolation and revalidation boundary

turns.prompt: A shared GET cache returned one tenant's authenticated response to another tenant and also served the wrong language variant. Read README.md, reproduce the failures, identify the end-to-end cause, and propose the smallest fix. Do not edit files yet.

Protocol owners confirmed additional rules: validate request and response header grammar before cache mutation; bypass shared storage for Authorization, Cookie, Range, and client conditionals; honor private, no-store, Set-Cookie, Vary:* and exact case-insensitive Vary dimensions; parse repeated cache directives and Age fail-closed; treat max-age equality as stale; revalidate stale entries with cache-owned validators; merge a 304's end-to-end metadata while preserving the body and recomputing its variant; permit stale-if-error only inside its strict bound; and single-flight only identical request representations while waking every waiter on success or failure. Revise the plan and explicitly invalidate URL-only keys, caching sensitive traffic, case-sensitive Vary, ignoring Age, inclusive freshness, replacing the body on 304, unbounded stale fallback, global coalescing, and failed-flight poisoning.
Approved: implement the smallest complete product fix, add deterministic regression tests if needed, run the complete public suite, and preserve operator_note.txt and all existing test authority.
